quote: For quality control, we also add roughly 2,000 quality-check entries—including gold label instances for which there was unanimous agreement among four annotators in earlier pilots and "attention-check" instances that explicitly ask annotators to select a specific label. We filter out all instances annotated by annotators who failed the attention checks or whose labels differed by at least two degrees from the gold labels... on more than 10% of their annotations.
guideline: Human annotators label the data, using annotator-quality control tests as exclusion criteria for dataset instances.
